# Bina Labs

> Bina Labs is an Israeli consultancy of engineers, researchers, and strategists that builds AI systems which earn their seat at the production table. Tel Aviv, Berlin, remote-first.

Bina Labs is led by three principals, Michael Fleicher (מיכאל פליישר in Hebrew), Ronen Chen, and Or Zilberberg. We work with companies who need real AI in production - not slideware. Median ship time is 11 days. 84% of clients return for a second engagement. We engage eight ways: AI strategy intensives, embedded engineering squads, lectures and workshops, applied research, innovation & grant strategy, machine vision & automated inspection, video analytics & tracking, and automation & smart reports.

Michael Fleicher is an engineer, data scientist, founder, and two-time CTO with backgrounds across MedTech, Insurance, Entertainment, and Semi-conductors. Building agentic systems and automations since 2017. Ronen Chen is an AI and deep-learning expert, innovation strategist, and funding advisor with 20+ years bridging advanced technology and commercial success - helping startups, SMEs, and research organizations secure competitive funding (Horizon Europe, EIC Accelerator, Eurostars, BIRD, Israel Innovation Authority). Or Zilberberg is a machine-learning and computer-vision engineer with a background in edge AI (Juganu) and precision optics (Flo Optics), building automated optical inspection for manufacturing, and automates business operations end to end - web scraping, data pipelines, and smart reports.

Operating principles: deadlines are holy; AI assistants are tools, not authors; honest deprecation (we tell clients when a project should die and refund the rest); built to leave (every embedded engagement comes with a written hand-off plan from day one).

## Selected case studies

- [Match Cuts](https://bina-labs.com/work/match-cuts): VLM-based auto-edited highlight reels from full football matches (90 min match condensed to 3 min per player)
- [Auto-QTO](https://bina-labs.com/work/auto-qto): Hybrid VLM extracting bills of materials from dense construction drawings (92% symbol recall)
- [Lloyd Score](https://bina-labs.com/work/lloyd-score): Spatial AI quantifying near-miss risk for marine insurers (AIS-grade ghost-fleet simulations)
- [Caseworker](https://bina-labs.com/work/caseworker): Embedded customer-experience copilot with smart sub-tree LLM, handwriting OCR, full CRM integration (-47% handle time)
- [All case studies](https://bina-labs.com/work): Full index of 17 selected engagements across vision, agents, data, and strategy - including Field Atlas (field-ops ETL), Telemetra (NL flight analysis), AskTable (self-healing SQL agent), Reachpoint (real-time hand ROM), Deskline, Forge Logistics, Priority Pilot, and more

## Services

- [AI Strategy](https://bina-labs.com/services): 4-week intensives. Where to bet, where to wait, what to ignore. Roadmap, evals, org-design
- [AI / Software Engineering](https://bina-labs.com/services): Embedded squads that ship product and the AI plumbing underneath - full-stack, RAG, agents, on-prem. Add-on: performance & GPU sizing for existing CV / ML pipelines
- [Lectures & Workshops](https://bina-labs.com/services): Tailored sessions for R&D teams and executives. What is real, what is one paper away, what is marketing. Add-on: AI-assisted engineering workshops on working with AI coding agents
- [Research](https://bina-labs.com/services): Applied research with frontier teams. Sometimes a paper. Occasionally a product
- [Innovation & Grant Strategy](https://bina-labs.com/services): Securing competitive funding (Horizon Europe, EIC Accelerator, Eurostars, BIRD, Israel Innovation Authority), business plans, and turning breakthrough technology into funded, scalable ventures
- [Machine Vision & Automated Inspection](https://bina-labs.com/services): Camera, optics, and models that replace manual visual and dimensional QC on production lines - defect detection, anomaly detection, measurement, sorting
- [Video Analytics & Tracking](https://bina-labs.com/services): Detection, multi-object tracking, re-identification, and OCR on long high-resolution video - sports, security, retail, traffic
- [Automation & Smart Reports](https://bina-labs.com/services): Unattended business workflows - web scraping, data pipelines, CRM and API integrations, smart reports with AI-written summaries

## Optional

- [Writing](https://bina-labs.com/writing): Long-form essays and field notes from production
- [Salesforce promised 1B AI agents and shipped ~3,000 - the 99.9% gap is organizational, not technical](https://bina-labs.com/writing/salesforce-ai-agents-99-percent-gap-organizational-readiness): Why Agentforce (and Microsoft Copilot Studio, Google Gemini agents, ServiceNow Now Assist) stalled. AI agents are digital coworkers, not software you install. The winning formula combines technical capability (tool use, retrieval, evals, guardrails, observability) with cultural readiness (named human owner, written role description, permission scope, KPI baseline, escalation rules). Three buyer-side filters: name the human owner before signing, write the job description before the prompt, demand a four-week pilot with a real KPI
- [GladBites and the B2B AI mirror](https://bina-labs.com/writing/gladbites-ai-content-machine-and-the-b2b-mirror): A TikTok cookbook funnel pulled $1.6M in 90 days with no kitchen. The same generative arbitrage is being run, right now, on enterprise AI buyers - here is the playbook and three buyer-side filters that defeat it
